variants.transformation: On nontrivial equivalent row-local quantizer paths only, compute common query/cache rows once and route matching quantized rows plus scales without forcing full-global readiness before local Q.

Elide only a separately proved redundant stable-index publication copy, preserving exact postprocess values, lengths, candidate bank generation and every observer. Current direct-output postprocess is baseline; helper return alias remains unverified.

conditions.requirement: Base/CP local indexed-hidden and qr row maps, physical PAD and valid extents remain exact; do not substitute full global hidden rows.
Shared index/candidate/length banks are valid only after the matching source layer publication within this forward. reset is no-op; cross-iteration pointer equality is insufficient.
Short-context, index-source, candidate-source and candidate-filter roles keep their distinct branch domains and folded-cache ownership.
Identical row-local quant function/scales/parameters and communication semantics are required; class equality or same shape alone is insufficient.
Unquantized/identity quantizers and already direct output/format views have no assumed device work to eliminate.
Partial quant reuse must preserve local Q early readiness, original main/aux events and useful vector/Cube overlap.
Preserve current prepare_indexer_indices position/compression mapping; do not replace block-ID candidates with token positions or skip opaque mapping.
Preserve -1 padding, K>topk nontruncation, INT32, leading-row slice/layout and stable shared-reader ABI.
Candidate lengths/topK lengths are separate optional banks; preserve max-cache0 clearing and all active/inactive readers.
Copy removal requires exact same range, full prior write, no conflicting alias and no version/debug/captured observer.
C2 metadata readiness and index old-latent read precede long in-place RoPE; preserve source cos/sin fallback and compression precision.
Packed mixed/prefill main publication versus aux publication selection remains exact; preserve join and exactly one cache writer.
Keep captured bank addresses/strides and input-ready/last-reader/reuse across graph and iteration boundaries; actual body audit remains M22.
No savings from source-only copies/formatting or logical bytes without positive actual work and critical-path analysis; overlapping variants are not additive.
